page_title: VER 1-2 GEN | Verona v Genoa 07/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+2' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Verona, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Verona have been awarded a corner kick.
89' Stefan Mitrovic (Verona) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
88' Alberto Gilardino decides to make a substitution. Albert Gudmundsson will be replaced by David Ankeye (Genoa).
85' That's a well-taken pass by Karol Swiderski (Verona). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
83' Here comes a substitution. Suat Serdar (Verona) is given a rest as he is replaced by Michael Folorunsho.

80' That didn't go as planned! Junior Messias (Genoa) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Lorenzo Montipo, who easily kept it out.
78' Alberto Gilardino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Djed Spence (Genoa) replacing Stefano Sabelli.
76' Verona get a corner.
74' Dangerous play by Karol Swiderski (Verona). Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Genoa, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Federico Bonazzoli (Verona) leaves the pitch and Thomas Henry comes on.
73' Celebrations are cut short for Verona as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
72' Wait! Referee Gianluca Manganiello has indicated he is going to review the Verona goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
71' Goal! Stefan Mitrovic puts the ball on a plate for Karol Swiderski (Verona), who scores with a simple close-range finish. It's 2:2.
69' There's an opportunity for Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

69' Lorenzo Montipo pulls off a fantastic save! Morten Thorsby (Genoa) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the left post, but the effort is kept out. Genoa will take a corner kick.
67' Gianluca Manganiello shows a yellow card to Suat Serdar (Verona) for his blatant foul.
66' Alberto Gilardino has decided to make a change. Emil Bohinen replaces Milan Badelj (Genoa).
66' Alberto Gilardino has decided to substitute Caleb Ekuban and he is replaced by Morten Thorsby (Genoa).
65' The ball is crossed into the box and Karol Swiderski (Verona) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the middle of the goal, but Josep Martinez gets a glove on it to thwart him.
63' Verona force their opponents to concede a corner.
62' Substitution. Darko Lazovic (Verona) makes way for Karol Swiderski.
62' Here is a change. Tomas Suslov is going off and Marco Baroni gives the last tactical orders to Stefan Mitrovic (Verona).
61' A lofted cross from Fabien Centonze (Verona) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Corner kick. Verona will have an opportunity.
60' A cross from a corner kick by Verona is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
58' 1 - 2 Goal! Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 1:2.
58' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Lorenzo Montipo pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.

56' My Gran could have done better! Federico Bonazzoli (Verona) got himself in a great position on the edge of the box after a pass, but put his shot well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
54' Darko Lazovic (Verona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Josep Martinez intercepts the ball.
50' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
49' Gianluca Manganiello blows the whistle, Fabien Centonze (Verona) is penalised for a foul. Genoa are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
46' Marco Baroni has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Daniel Silva (Verona) comes on the pitch for Ondrej Duda.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' Gianluca Manganiello has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' 1 - 1 Goal! 1:1. The ball rebounds to Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) after a melee in the box, and he easily beats the keeper from close range.
45' A pass into the penalty area from Ridgeciano Haps (Genoa) is intercepted by the defence.
40' Ondrej Duda (Verona) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
39' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
38' Rough tackle by Milan Badelj (Genoa). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
34' Suat Serdar (Verona) has time on the edge of the box. His shot is disappointing, though, as it flies towards the middle of the goal where Josep Martinez makes a comfortable save.
33' Milan Badelj (Genoa) brings his opponent down. Gianluca Manganiello has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Verona will take a free kick.

29' A long pass finds Morten Frendrup (Genoa) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
25' It must be a yellow card. It is. Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
24' Fabien Centonze (Verona) has tested the patience of referee Gianluca Manganiello and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
24' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Genoa.
20' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) climbs high to connect with a cross on the edge of the box and fires in an excellent bullet header which hits the crossbar. What a chance!
20' Genoa force a corner. They send men into the box.

18' Juan Cabal (Verona) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went way over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
18' Verona have a corner.
16' Verona are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
14' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) is penalised for holding. Gianluca Manganiello signals a set piece. Free kick. Verona will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.

8' 1 - 0 Federico Bonazzoli (Verona) runs on to a clever pass from Darko Lazovic and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He still has work to do but finishes with aplomb into the back of the net.
5' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
5' Gianluca Manganiello interrupts the game. One of the players from Genoa won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. A free kick has been awarded to Verona.
3' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Genoa, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
3' A player from Verona commits a rough challenge. Gianluca Manganiello blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Genoa have been awarded a free kick.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Verona will kick the game off.
Gianluca Manganiello was nominated as the referee for this game.
